Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

You will join our global Web3 growth and ecosystem team and support the global growth and ecosystem development of broader Web3 initiatives.
This is a global role working closely with cross-functional teams across multiple markets and regions to identify opportunities.
Responsibilities will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Role Overview

This is a global Web3 growth and ecosystem role, based in Hong Kong and operating across markets. We are looking for a globally minded operations professional who is deeply involved in the on-chain ecosystem, understands diverse on-chain user communities, and can independently plan and execute campaigns across regions.
 
You will work around X Layer and OKX Wallet to connect ecosystem projects, communities, and users worldwide; bring high-quality applications to real users; and turn campaign participation into sustained on-chain usage and ecosystem growth.
 
This focuses respectively on public blockchain ecosystem partnerships and operations and global Wallet user growth and campaign operations. Both require strong ecosystem knowledge, cross-market user insight, and end-to-end campaign execution capabilities.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Ecosystem Research and Opportunity Identification: Continuously track leading public blockchains and sectors such as DeFi, on-chain trading, and consumer applications across global markets. Identify projects with product value, an established user base, and growth potential, and develop actionable partnership and operational plans.
  • Ecosystem Partnerships and Development: Build and maintain relationships with project teams, communities, and ecosystem partners across regions. Drive globally scalable co-marketing campaigns, application promotion, and user education, while continuously tracking post-launch activity and growth.
  • Global User Insights and Operations: Engage deeply with on-chain user communities across markets to understand the motivations, decision-making habits, and barriers faced by different user segments. Establish user segmentation and feedback mechanisms, and optimise the conversion journey from first-time experience to ongoing usage.
  • Campaign Planning and Execution: Independently lead global and regional ecosystem co-marketing campaigns, on-chain quests, trading campaigns, community incentive programs, AMAs, and online/offline events. Own target-setting, campaign mechanics, budget planning, resource coordination, launch execution, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Growth and Data Analysis: Define metrics around qualified new users, first on-chain interactions, activity, retention, and partner-project growth. Evaluate performance using on-chain and product data, and continuously optimize participation requirements, incentive mechanisms, and operational investment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Data, and regional teams to turn user feedback into product and operational improvements, ensuring a seamless connection between campaigns and the product experience.
 
 

What We Look For In You

  • Experience in Web3 ecosystem operations, user growth, community operations, or campaign operations. Able to provide complete case studies of projects personally led, with verifiable results.
  • Long-term, hands-on participation in the on-chain ecosystem. Proficient in using wallets, DEXs, cross-chain bridges, and mainstream DApps; understands core concepts such as token approvals, gas fees, slippage, and liquidity; and can independently conduct product-experience and user-journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with on-chain users and their communities. Understands behavioral differences among trading-focused, DeFi-focused, and task-driven users, and can distinguish short-term, incentive-driven participation from needs that support sustained usage.
  • Understanding of public blockchain ecosystem-building dynamics, including project onboarding, application distribution, user acquisition, liquidity, and communities. Able to design partnership proposals that create value for both project teams and users.
  • Proven experience independently planning and executing campaigns. Able to clearly articulate campaign objectives, target audience, mechanics, budget, execution process, and final outcomes, and propose improvements based on post-campaign reviews.
  • Strong data mindset, with the ability to analyze operational conversion funnels, user retention, and campaign costs. Accountable for genuine user growth and business outcomes.
  • Strong communication, project-management, and execution skills; able to drive projects in a fast-paced, globally distributed, cross-functional environment. Professional English communication and copywriting skills are required to work effectively with international projects, communities, and internal stakeholders. Additional language capabilities and experience operating across multiple markets are advantageous.
 
 
Preferred Global Experience
  • Deep involvement in on-chain ecosystems such as RWA and Meme, with an understanding of user personas, community culture, asset issuance, and trading mechanics across different sectors. Relevant project operations or growth experience is preferred.
  • Ongoing attention to and hands-on experience with emerging protocols such as Tapeout. Able to analyze product mechanics, user participation journeys, and growth opportunities, and translate these into concrete partnership or campaign proposals.
  • Experience in Meme community operations, trend-based campaign planning, or on-chain trading campaigns. Able to manage communication timing and drive community participation and user conversion.
  • Experience in user education, ecosystem partnerships, or campaign planning for RWA projects. Able to translate complex product mechanisms into clear, easy-to-understand content and participation flows.
  • An active global network of on-chain users, project teams, trading communities, or content creators, with the ability to independently drive cross-market partnerships and produce verifiable growth results.
  • Demonstrated success in converting early momentum around emerging sectors or protocols into Wallet usage, on-chain interactions, and sustained retention.

A junior Controls Analyst sits in the second line and does the groundwork that keeps the control environment visible — maintaining the inventory, gathering evidence, testing controls.

Core responsibilities

Risk and control framework
  • Maintain the approved control inventory, including control descriptions, owners, frequency and evidence requirements; process additions through the agreed governance process.
  • Map controls to processes, risks and applicable obligations. Identify control gaps, duplicate controls, outdated records and missing ownership for review.
  • Support Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycles by collecting inputs, checking completeness and recording changes to risks, controls and action plans.
Evidence and control testing
  • Request and organise evidence from control owners across departments, maintain an accessible audit trail and follow up on overdue submissions.

  • Document the test scope, sample, evidence, results and conclusion. Distinguish control failures from cases that cannot be tested because evidence is unavailable, and escalate material findings.
Issues and remediation

  • Monitor threshold breaches and adverse trends, investigate anomalies with control owners, and escalate exceptions with clear context and action status through periodic risk reports and governance meetings.
GRC records and audit support
  • Keep risk, control, process, evidence and issue records current in the GRC tool; run data quality checks and prepare standard reporting extracts.
  • Prepare relevant records and evidence for internal audit, external audit and regulatory reviews in coordination with the wider team.

  • One to three years of relevant experience in operational risk, internal controls, internal audit, compliance or a regulated operating environment.
  • Strong Excel skills, including the ability to consolidate and check data, use formulas and pivot tables, and build clear dashboards or management reports.

Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity.   • Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.

  • Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

 

This role is for you if:

  • You have strong product security fundamentals and can improve secure-by-default patterns in fast-moving engineering teams.

  • You have led end-to-end rollout of security controls in production, from design and implementation through adoption and evidence.

  • You regularly influence architecture decisions before launch through fast, lightweight risk reviews and pragmatic controls.

  • You are comfortable writing production-grade code or infrastructure changes, not only policy or tickets.

  • You use AI tooling to accelerate security reviews and remediation planning without lowering quality or signal.

  • You push ambiguous work forward without waiting for a complete playbook, and you bring stakeholders with you.

This is not for you if:

  • You prefer advisory-only security roles and do not want direct implementation ownership.

  • You need tightly scoped tickets to make progress and are uncomfortable defining the plan yourself.

  • You avoid ownership of production systems and control implementation work.

  • You optimize for stability over change and are not excited by early-stage ambiguity.

 

Hard Requirements

  • Extensive experience in hands-on security engineering, product security, cloud security, or detection/response engineering in production environments

  • Demonstrated expertise securing cloud-based systems (IAM, networking, logging, key management, workload isolation) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Proven experience building at least one security automation or detection capability that is actively used in production

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment with audit and control evidence requirements

  • Experience with modern security tooling, especially SIEM/SOAR and cloud security platforms

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) Berlin and able to work in-office 3 days/week

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

You will serve as a front-line manager for a team of Sales Development Representatives, responsible for outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Ramp’s SMB segment.

You will lead and evolve the SMB sales development motion by providing 1:1 coaching, onboarding, training, and mentorship; setting team strategy; and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Executive Leadership to drive pipeline and business outcomes.

As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in developing SDR talent, scaling effective outbound practices, and continuously refining Ramp’s SMB go-to-market motion.

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale the SMB SDR function by evolving team operating rhythms, playbooks, coaching standards, and processes for an open-territory outbound motion.

  • Set and maintain a high-performing culture by overseeing daily SDR activity, pipeline generation, and quota performance to ensure key performance metrics are met.

  • Hire, onboard, and train new SDRs on Ramp’s products, buyer personas, competitive landscape, prospecting strategy, and tools through hands-on methods including role-plays.

  • Develop and execute career-growth and leadership plans for direct reports, including daily 1:1 mentorship and coaching on time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, active listening, and pipeline creation.

  • Coach SDRs on effective multichannel outbound prospecting, including account research, relevant messaging, call execution, and using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality.

  • Partner with AEs and Sales and Marketing counterparts on pipeline-generation, territory, and prospecting initiatives that support SMB business objectives.

  • Report on team performance, pipeline health, and forecasts to senior leadership.

  • Improve team output and efficiency over time by identifying opportunities to optimize systems, processes, enablement, and AI-supported workflows.

  • Establish and maintain a library of prospecting resources, best practices, and training materials for the SMB SDR team.

  • Represent the SMB Sales Development team cross-functionally with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and other departments.

What You Need

  • Minimum of 2 years of quota-carrying sales experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record exceeding goals

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience building and leading sales development teams with a proven track record of exceeding goal

  • Prior demonstrated success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS companies, and history of consistently performing above quota in an outbound sales environment

  • A passion and excitement for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development

  • Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including executive leaders

  • Proficiency in data analytics tools (ie. Salesforce, Looker, and Excel) and familiarity with email and call automation platforms

  • High proficiency with AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, etc.), with the ability to incorporate tooling into prospecting, coaching, team workflows, and process improvement to drive greater SDR productivity

  • Ability to leverage data to drive decisions, create systems, and identify process improvements to improve efficiency

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, demonstrated through excellent communication and presentation skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with financial services sales in a full cycle sales role

  • Experience at a high-growth startup

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Security is a primary competency at Coinbase, and the Threat Intelligence team within Security Operations keeps a watchful eye over every aspect of it. As a Senior Threat Intelligence Engineer, you'll combine deep technical expertise in tracking sophisticated adversaries with innovative AI engineering to protect billions of dollars in digital assets. You'll turn internal and external signals into durable detections and actionable intelligence, partnering across the entire organization to bring insights directly to the stakeholders who make risk-based decisions.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly driven Global Campaign Lead to own the strategy and execution of global campaigns across the platform.
This role requires a deep understanding of crypto markets, exchange products, trading users, and user lifecycle, combined with strong market sense across TradFi and global assets. The ideal candidate actively trades, understands how user needs change across market conditions and lifecycle stages, and can turn these insights into campaign and cross-sell opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own global campaigns end-to-end, from strategy, mechanics, and user journey to execution, optimization, and performance review.
  • Lead major platform initiatives including trading competitions, product launches, asset campaigns, seasonal campaigns, and flagship global events.
  • Build campaign strategies around the user lifecycle, covering activation, trading engagement, multi-product adoption, retention, and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities from market movements, user behavior, product updates, and emerging trends across Crypto and TradFi, and translate them into relevant campaigns.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities by matching user needs with the right products, tools, and trading strategies under different market conditions.
  • Work closely with Product, Growth, Brand, BD, Data, and Regional teams to deliver complex global initiatives.
  • Measure campaign performance based on business impact, including active traders, trading volume, revenue, product adoption, retention, and ROI.
  • Lead the Global Campaign team, set clear priorities, and continuously improve campaign frameworks and execution efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in growth, campaign operations, user operations, or related roles, preferably in crypto exchanges, fintech, brokerage, or trading-related businesses.
  • Proven experience in user lifecycle operations, with a strong understanding of activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell, and reactivation.
  • Deep understanding of the crypto industry, exchange products, trading mechanics, and user behavior.
  • Active trading experience, with a genuine habit of exploring different products, trading tools, and strategies.
  • Strong market sense across Crypto and TradFi, with the ability to connect market conditions, user needs, and product opportunities.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and evaluate incremental business impact.
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional projects in a fast-moving organization.
  • Strong ownership, ambition, and resilience, with the ability to perform under pressure and take responsibility for results.
  • Fluent in both English and Chinese as working languages.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE.

What We Value

We value people who trade, understand users, stay close to the market, and get things done.
You should understand who the user is, where they are in their lifecycle, what the market is doing, and what product they need next — and be able to turn that understanding into campaigns that drive real business growth.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Who We Are

The Solana Foundation is a non-profit based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the adoption, decentralization, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a high performance blockchain that can deliver a fast and friendly user experience, without sacrificing security. The Solana Foundation is working to realize a world where individuals own their data, use permissionless networks, and transfer information and value freely around the world. We are looking for talented people who are willing to jump right in and use their expertise to help the ecosystem build.

What We Do

The Solana Foundation's marketing and communications team tells the story of what is being built on Solana. We work across developers and founders, traders and crypto-native users, institutions and capital-market participants, payments companies and merchants, enterprises and consumer platforms, and the policymakers and media who shape how all of it is understood. We are deliberately lean, fast, and close to the work.

The Opportunity

Banks, asset managers, and financial infrastructure providers are building on Solana. Tokenized assets, stablecoin rails and always-on markets have moved from thesis to pipeline. What we do not yet have is a dedicated marketing capability that speaks to those buyers in their language, at their pace, with the evidence they need.

We are looking for an Institutional Growth Marketing Lead to own that audience end to end. You will define who we are talking to, build the campaigns and content that reach them, and give our institutional business development team the material they need to move deals forward. This is a growth role with a credibility problem to solve: the work only lands if an allocator or a head of digital assets at a major bank finds it genuinely useful.

You will be based in New York, close to the institutions we serve, and will work alongside our BD, data, events and communications teams.

To be Successful in this role

You will:

  • Segment the institutional and capital-markets audience down to named accounts and specific personas.

  • Develop and execute integrated campaigns around tokenization and internet capital markets across owned, earned, and partner channels.

  • Build sales enablement materials for Institutional BD, including narratives, decks, one-pagers, objection handling, and a maintained content library.

  • Produce flagship research and reports in partnership with the Data team, creating work that gets cited rather than skimmed.

  • Drive event and partnership activation alongside the Events team, with Breakpoint serving as the anchor moment.

  • Measure institutional engagement and pipeline influence in partnership with BD, establishing clear success metrics and reporting results honestly.

You ideally have:

  • Substantial experience marketing to institutional financial audiences - asset managers, banks, allocators, market infrastructure, or fintech serving those buyers

  • Demonstrated ownership of a full-funnel program, not just campaign execution: you have defined the audience, built the plan, and been accountable for what it produced

  • The ability to write with authority for a sophisticated financial reader, and the judgment to know when a claim needs a source

  • Experience building sales enablement that a commercial team actually uses

  • Comfort with research and data: you can brief an analysis, interrogate the output, and turn it into a narrative that holds

  • A working understanding of digital assets and where tokenization, stablecoins and market structure are genuinely heading

  • Fluency with AI tooling for research, segmentation, drafting and campaign analysis

Bonus points:

  • You have sat on the institutional side at a bank, fund, or market infrastructure provider.
    You have experience in the fintech or blockchain industry.

  • Experience launching a research franchise or flagship industry report

  • An existing network among institutional digital-asset teams

  • You can hold your own in a room with both a crypto-native founder and a chief investment officer
